faqs.question: What are the major upgrades of DJI Air 3S compared to DJI Air 3?
faqs.answer: DJI Air 3S features an upgraded 1-inch CMOS primary camera (vs 1/1.3-inch on Air 3), forward-facing LiDAR for nighttime omnidirectional obstacle sensing, next-generation Smart RTH that functions in low light without satellite signals, and 42GB of built-in storage with Off-State QuickTransfer.

faqs.question: Does DJI Air 3S support vertical shooting and panorama modes?
faqs.answer: Yes! DJI Air 3S supports 2.7K Vertical Shooting across both cameras, plus a brand new Free Panorama feature that lets you customize the shooting range and stitch expansive panoramas with either camera lens.

faqs.question: Which remote controllers are compatible with DJI Air 3S?
faqs.answer: DJI Air 3S is fully compatible with DJI RC-N3, DJI RC 2 (with built-in 5.5-inch 1080p 700-nit screen), and DJI RC-N2 remote controllers.

faqs.question: Does my DJI Air 3S come with official Australian warranty from D1 Store?
faqs.answer: Yes. All DJI products sold by D1 Store are 100% genuine Australian stock and include the full 2-Year Official Australian Manufacturer Warranty and local Australian DJI-certified repair service.

videoShowcases.title: Dual Primary Cameras — 1-inch CMOS & 70mm Telephoto
videoShowcases.description: Both cameras feature 10-bit D-Log M and HLG color modes. The 50MP 1-inch primary camera and 48MP 70mm medium telephoto camera deliver consistent cinematic color science across all focal lengths.

videoShowcases.title: Nightscape Omnidirectional Sensing with Forward LiDAR
videoShowcases.description: The first consumer drone to incorporate forward-facing LiDAR. Combined with infrared ToF sensors and vision cameras, Air 3S detects obstacles effortlessly even at night for secure nighttime return-to-home.

videoShowcases.title: Free Panorama & ActiveTrack 360°
videoShowcases.description: Seamlessly stitch ultra-wide panoramic landscape compositions, while ActiveTrack 360° keeps subjects locked in cinematic framing with automatic terrain avoidance.
